claims.claim: The eligible A-share mother universe contains 364 parent-profit preview companies mapped to all 31 Shenwan first-level industries after excluding 4 B-share securities.
A uniform rule identifies 73 high-impact preview candidates, of which 63 were outside the prior 54-name thematic universe.

After positive-growth, price-history, quality, position and trend gates, the priority evidence pool contains 16 names: one quiet, eleven low-position earnings, and four launched-with-runway candidates.
Coal is the only silent-accumulation industry with a high-impact preview candidate, but Shaanxi Coal's probability value is below current price.
The formal valuation pool contains five names and every bear value is below current price.
ZTE, Jiangbolong and Shaanxi Coal remain conditional watches because their probability values are below current price or key segment/cycle evidence is incomplete.
Hengrui's final model separates innovative-drug DCF, generics/other and licensing economics and does not double-count the unhaircut Huatai Street SOTP.
Industrial Fulian's H1 preview implies Q2 parent profit of CNY13.305bn, while the base full-year model requires H2 parent profit of CNY32.11bn.
All positive-weight Street anchors are ticker-matched original PDFs; detailed repost targets carry zero weight.
The prior 54-name and 56-PDF archive remains a thematic deep-dive appendix and no longer represents the full-market mother universe.
The final PDF contains the 31/364/73/16/5/3 hierarchy, has zero Overfull boxes, zero out-of-bounds words and unique exhibit identifiers.
All sixteen priority names have company-level bear/base/bull models and probability targets.
All seventy-three H1 high-impact candidates have valuation rows: seventy-two are priceable and one has an explicit no-valid-price reason.
The deduplicated report-wide valuation ledger covers 117 names; 116 are priceable and Changxin Technology has an official IPO pre-pricing boundary rather than a fabricated secondary-market target.

All 44 thematic-only names have 2026Q1 financial packets and a valid original broker PDF; 42 have positive original-report 2026E EPS denominators, while DeepTech and Tom Cat use explicitly downgraded evidence paths.

All 117 report names have a ticker-level evidence closure row; 114 close directly, two close through valuation downgrade and one is an official IPO timing boundary, with zero unresolved material gaps.

Nine names previously marked as not found in the 2026-07-11 capture now have official H1 preview PDFs through 2026-07-15; the update separates clean operating delivery, material non-recurring income, price-advanced delivery and the AVIC Shenyang Aircraft earnings decline.
